page.overview:
Who is Serancha Colvine?

She has a pinched mouth and pinched nose, that constantly seems to be detecting a bad smell. She has light brown hair and pale blue eyes. Even her pale eyes seem pinched with disapproval. She might well have been considered pretty otherwise. She has tight, cramped handwriting.

No information is given about Serancha's strength in the One Power in either the books or the Companion. Both Sitters and Ajah Heads can be either weak or strong in the One Power, so no inferences can be made.

Serancha was born in the year and went to the White Tower in at the age of 15.

She spent seven years as novice and six as Accepted and appears to have made a few enemies. She was Accepted over both Seaine Herimon and Pevara Tazanovni. All three were later Accepted together. Pevara regards her as a prig suitable for the Gray.
